title: Nolus (pirin-1) governance capture — capital capture uneconomic; residual validator-deception migration risk
closed_reasons: No permissionless (E-U) path exists: all value sits behind governance (CP spend / wasm sudo migration) or remote Solana-side systems; no public function pays an unprivileged caller

Capital capture uneconomic: quorum-only floor requires 106.6M NLS (~$400k, own-stake denominator correction; the $272k claim is wrong); empirical hostile-vote bloc (162.3M NLS NoWithVeto, prop 295) implies 324.7M NLS (~$1.19M) to survive veto; NLS market depth is 2.2M NLS visible asks and $62.4k/day all-venue volume, so real acquisition cost is multiples of spot

Proceeds are illiquid: CP = 240.0M NLS + $0.05 dust; immediate market sale ~$1.9k (MEXC bids); slow-sale of 392.0M NLS (42% of supply) optimistic $196-588k; net vs liquid proceeds -$271k (floor) to -$1.07M (opposed)
No other module-account pot is gov-spendable: fee pool is delegator rewards, staking pools are bookkeeping, vestings/wasm/fee_collector/interchainaccounts empty; IBC escrow is user funds
Osmosis/Neutron markets sunset (DefiLlama hallmarks), ICA-side balances ~$0; Solana-side positions (~$228k DL snapshot) not reached without unverified remote-lease/relayer trust assumptions
No MsgCommunityPoolSpend has ever executed on this chain (tx search: 0); governance history is 99/100 passed with all pin/migrate proposals 100% Yes

poc.ci_verification: data-job (keyless re-fetch of all chain/market inputs + deterministic model re-run; success, block 27,324,402)

key_facts: Gov params (ABCI, h 27,319,295): quorum 33.4%, threshold 50%, veto 33.4%, voting 3 days, min deposit 200 NLS (~$0.73)
Bonded 212,518,285.80 NLS at h 27,319,1xx; 217.16M at CI h 27,324,402 (+2.2% intraday); 19 validators; top-3 = 37.0% of bonded; unbonding 21 days
NLS spot $0.00364916 ($0.00367039 at CI); total supply 922.94M; mcap ~$3.25M; all-venue 24h volume $62.4k (MEXC $57.1k, Raydium $5.25k, Osmosis $23)
MEXC NLS/USDT book: 2.158M NLS total asks (1.85M within 2x mid), $1,926 bids — buying 106.6M NLS = 49x the visible book

Capture costs: claim basis 70.98M NLS/$259k; quorum floor (own-stake corrected) 106.58M NLS/$389k; threshold vs 80% turnout 170.0M/$620k; veto survival vs 162.3M NWV 324.66M/$1,185k; all-validators-NWV 347.5M/$1,241k
Community pool = 240,000,000.95 NLS + $0.05 micro-dust (USDC/ATOM/OSMO/NTRN balances are micro-unit dust, NOT $47k)
Protocol treasury contract holds 152,008,181.07 NLS (+$2.6 dust), accruing ~130 NLS/h from tx fees (x/tax fee_rate=100%, gov-updatable)
LPP vaults (Solana Metis, carried on Nolus): $97.1k USDC + $14.1k SOL + $6.4k cbBTC + $0.8k WETH = $118.3k — the only liquid pot; decimals validated vs DefiLlama ($116.9k idle TVL on 2026-10-04)
Gov-movable nominal total $1.55M (392.0M NLS = 42% of supply + $118.3k carried); liquid total $118.5k

Attack mechanics proven: wasm keeper authority = gov module (can open code_upload_access via MsgUpdateParams); Admin-contract sudo migrate_contracts honors explicit per-contract code_id including platform treasury (props 277/299/306/313/329/345) and protocol contracts (props 371/373); versioning checks are self-attested by the target code
Empirical opposition: prop 295 (scam) rejected with NoWithVeto = 162,331,398 NLS (76% of bonded); all 99 other proposals passed, all pin/migrate 100% Yes
Net capital-capture vs liquid proceeds: -$271k (floor spot), -$1.07M (empirical veto), -$1.05M (floor at 3x slippage) — before the attacker's own NLS exit overhang

Residual deception path: 1-2 proposals (open upload; pin+sudo-migrate; potentially bundleable) at ~$0.73/200 NLS deposit cost could drain treasury+LPP ($118.5k liquid, $1.43M NLS nominal); success depends on validators approving visibly non-team proposals
caveats: Point-in-time reads 2026-10-09 (primary h 27,319,088; CI h 27,324,402); NLS price/depth move and bonded rose intraday

Admin/treasury contract source is not public; interfaces recovered from deployed wasm (code 913/911/906/958/979) strings and executed governance proposals — mechanics strongly evidenced, not fork-executed (Cosmos chain, no EVM fork; no transactions sent per campaign rules)
NLS slow-sale scenarios are optimistic (assume price does not collapse while 42% of supply is distributed)
Solana-side positions (~$228k DefiLlama 2026-10-04) and the relayer trust model were not assessed; flagged as extension
Deception-path success probability is not quantifiable from on-chain data (depends on validator diligence)
one_liner: External unprivileged extraction $0; Nolus capture is not the claimed $272k-vs-$895k arbitrage: quorum-corrected floor is ~$389-400k, realistic opposition $0.62-1.19M, while proceeds are 93%+ illiquid NLS (CP 240.0M NLS + $0.05 dust; immediate depth ~$1.9k) and the only liquid pot is $118.3k of carried LPP assets — capital capture is deeply net-negative; residual risk is a low-capital validator-deception migration path whose mechanics are proven but whose payoff is liquidity-bounded (~$0.1-0.6M).
